newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: 23 die in two South African bus crashes.
newsitem.headline: 23 die in two South African bus crashes.

text.p: At least 23 South Africans were killed in two bus accidents on Friday, one of them possibly caused when the bus driver flirted with a woman passenger, traffic officials said.
They said 10 people, five of them children, were killed in KwaZulu-Natal province when their bus hit an embankment and overturned.
"We have been told that the driver was fiddling with a woman passenger on the bus and was not paying attention to the road," traffic information officer Gary Ronald said.
Police said 13 people were killed in when their bus left the road near Villiers in Free State province. The cause of the crash was not known.
